value: The retained in-memory store method couples the exact current verified ActionIR artifact, persisted policy/grant/resource/epoch/replacement receipt/time watermark, deterministic authorization, owner CAS, business effects, and an authorization-bound receipt in one candidate commit. No HTTP route or durable database adapter is retained. INV-AUTH-CAPABILITY-NOW remains partial because other authoritative mutation families, network authority provisioning, and strong-receipt evidence projection remain outside this slice; the kernel also does not derive the proposed effect from the artifact's optional closed effect program.
